description.content: Search and retrieve cultural heritage item metadata records

Search DPLA's aggregated metadata of 50 million+ cultural heritage items from 4,000+ US institutions. Supports full-text search, field-level queries, boolean and wildcard operators, geographic distance queries, date range filtering, and faceted aggregations. Returns JSON-LD records.

query.description: Full-text search query. Supports boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT), wildcard characters (* and ?), and phrase matching with quotes.

Comma-separated list of fields to return as facets (aggregations). Facetable fields include: sourceResource.subject.name, sourceResource.type, sourceResource.format, provider.name, dataProvider.name, sourceResource.language.name, sourceResource.spatial.state, sourceResource.date.begin, rights, admin.contributingInstitution, and others.
Maximum number of values to return per facet.
Comma-separated list of fields to include in each result document. Limits returned fields to the specified subset.
Field name to sort results by.
Geographic coordinate pin (lat,lon) used for distance-based sorting when sort_by is set to a coordinates field.
Boolean operator used to combine multiple field query terms.
When true, field queries match exact values rather than using analyzed/tokenized matching.
Filter expression to apply to results without affecting relevance scoring. Format is field:value. Can be specified multiple times.
Filter by title of the cultural heritage item.
Filter by type (e.g., image, text, sound, moving image, interactive resource, physical object, collection, dataset).
Filter by format of the item.
Filter by date range begin (ISO 8601 or year).
Filter by date range end (ISO 8601 or year).
Filter for items dated after the specified value.
Filter for items dated before the specified value.
Filter by geographic coordinates in lat,lon format. Can be used with sort_by_pin for distance-based queries.
Filter by URL where item is shown at the source institution.
Filter by URL of a related digital view.
Your DPLA API key. Alternatively, pass as Authorization header. Required for all requests.

info.name: Digital Public Library of America (DPLA) Authentication Items API

description.content:
The Digital Public Library of America (DPLA) provides a free REST API that gives access to metadata for 50 million+ cultural heritage items aggregated from 4,000+ US libraries, archives, and museums. The API supports full-text search, field-specific queries, geographic and date range filtering, faceted browsing, and JSONP callbacks. All results are returned as JSON-LD. API keys are issued free of charge via a self-service email-based registration endpoint.
